Hi Claire — thanks for the detailed note and for looping in security.

Short answer: yes, we can sequester a single conversation (scope-limited) from telemetry and audit exports for your account. To proceed we need:
1) A signed redaction/authorization form (standard template) from an authorized contact.
2) Exact message UID(s) or a short transcript snippet to identify the conversation boundaries (you noted approx timestamp and your internal id ew-chat-4491 — that helps).
3) Confirmation that Everwell accepts the remedial tradeoffs (removal from telemetry means the entry will be omitted from some historical analytics and may not be recoverable without preserved backups).

Process and timeline (typical):
- Once we receive the signed form, our privacy ops team will validate and create an internal sequester job.
- Engineering performs the sequester and we run a post-check to confirm removal from telemetry exports (typically 2–3 business days after authorization).
- We'll provide a completion certificate and short evidence file.

I attached the standard redaction form and a short checklist. If you can sign and return, we’ll kick off the job. If you prefer, I can route this to our privacy specialist (Neha) to handle the authorization / compliance review — CC'd.

Best,
